title: Tai Tam Upper Reservoir Masonry Bridge
geometryBasis: Masonry bridge registered to the original OpenStreetMap way 300791897. The cleared Qualla view and heritage record identify the road crossing above the former byewash.
sectionBasis: Low straight deck with dressed masonry piers, projecting corbel caps, and two longitudinal metal safety rails on each side.
limitations: The mapped endpoints set the span and heading. Deck width, pier spacing, surface colors and railing geometry are estimates based on the public-domain photograph and the single-lane context.
The original 5 m terrain field anchors the road approaches. Pier footing depth, deck height and the buried abutment faces are approximate.
